notes.title: Update of demo v0.13
notes.content:
1. Fix bug of monster loss and UI loss in Kowloon Battle

2. Fix some bugs in the interaction task process

3. Fix dialogue plot bug

4. Add scene transition images, fix bug where progress bar repeatedly reads

notes.title: The update of demo v0.12
notes.content:
1. Fixed the bug where the scene of entering the prison cell for the first time was not saved.

2. Fixed a bug where there was an error during the death rollback process at the Kowloon Boss station.

3. Fixed the issue where data information for talent trees, skill additions, and equipment cannot be synchronized after the character's death.

4. Optimize map resource loading to reduce the problem of black screen freezing caused by it.

notes.title: The update of demo v0.11
notes.content:
1. Fixed the black screen issue in the overhauled scene. 

2. Fixed the issue of frequent chain release when players fight with the Big Eye (now the Big Eye releases a chain attack every round). 

3. Optimized the warrior combat scene. 

4. Optimized the handle UI navigation on the skill page. 

5. Optimized the hit timing of the second phase attack of the Night Wandering God. 

6. Added a progress bar display for scene loading
